FC Hero acquisition.zh: 英雄通过建造奇观或探索遗迹获得。点击英雄、科技或来源名称可查看对应条目。
FC Hero acquisition.en: Obtain heroes by constructing wonders or exploring ancient ruins. Follow the links for heroes, technologies and their sources.

FC Hero source H01.en: Obtain: complete Throne of Military Oaths.

FC Hero source H02.en: Obtain: complete Gallery of Star Charts.

FC Visitor cap.zh: 以下8位英雄合计最多同时拥有2位；同一位英雄不能重复拥有。世界奇观获得的4位英雄不占这个名额。
FC Visitor cap.en: You may own at most two of the following eight heroes in total, with no duplicate of the same hero. The four world-wonder heroes do not count toward this limit.

FC Hero source H05.zh: 在遗迹遭遇【泉路上的最后一担】中选择招募，支付160金币；还需拥有城市并满足事件的生命、资源等条件。
FC Hero source H05.en: Recruit in “The Last Load on Springroad” for 160 Gold. You must own a city and meet the encounter’s health, resource and other requirements.

FC Hero source H06.zh: 在遗迹遭遇【刻名者的条件】中选择招募，支付240金币；还需拥有城市并满足事件的生命、资源等条件。
FC Hero source H06.en: Recruit in “A Voluntary Soul Covenant” for 240 Gold. You must own a city and meet the encounter’s health, resource and other requirements.

FC Hero source H07.zh: 在遗迹遭遇【熔印不会替你选目标】中选择招募，支付320金币；还需拥有城市并满足事件的生命、资源等条件。
FC Hero source H07.en: Recruit in “The Molten Seal Envoy” for 320 Gold. You must own a city and meet the encounter’s health, resource and other requirements.

FC Hero source H08.zh: 在遗迹遭遇【静镜值守】中选择招募，支付160金币；还需拥有城市并满足事件的生命、资源等条件。
FC Hero source H08.en: Recruit in “The Silent Mirror Watch” for 160 Gold. You must own a city and meet the encounter’s health, resource and other requirements.

FC Hero source H10.zh: 在遗迹遭遇【林间灯火】中选择招募，支付240金币；还需拥有城市并满足事件的生命、资源等条件。
FC Hero source H10.en: Recruit in “Lanterns in the Grove” for 240 Gold. You must own a city and meet the encounter’s health, resource and other requirements.

FC Hero source H12.zh: 在遗迹遭遇【驿道护卫】中选择招募，支付400金币；还需拥有城市并满足事件的生命、资源等条件。
FC Hero source H12.en: Recruit in “Guards by the Old Road” for 400 Gold. You must own a city and meet the encounter’s health, resource and other requirements.

FC Ruins introduction.zh: 进入古代遗迹会随机获得一种当前符合条件的奖励，或打开一次探索遭遇。下列科技是探索资格，研究完成本身不会触发事件。
FC Ruins introduction.en: Entering an ancient ruin selects an eligible reward or opens an exploration encounter. Technology requirements below unlock eligibility; completing research does not itself trigger an encounter.

FC Ruin RU04.zh: 已有城市时，随机一座本方城市增加1人口。
FC Ruin RU04.en: if you own a city, one random city gains 1 population.

FC Ruin RU05.zh: 以距遗迹4格的随机地块为中心，其3格内的地块各有70%概率被揭示。
FC Ruin RU05.en: around a random tile 4 tiles from the ruin, each tile within radius 3 has a 70% chance to be revealed.

FC Ruin RU06.en: gain 30 Faith when religion is enabled.

FC Ruin RU08.zh: 探索的军事单位获得10经验。
FC Ruin RU08.en: the exploring military unit gains 10 XP.

FC Ruin RU09.zh: 受伤的探索单位恢复30生命，最多恢复至满生命。
FC Ruin RU09.en: a wounded exploring unit heals up to 30 HP.

FC Ruin RU10.zh: 研究安魂与记忆后，获得50文化。
FC Ruin RU10.en: after researching Repose and Memory, gain 50 Culture.

FC Ruin RU11.zh: 揭示8格范围内的荒野营地。

FC Ruin RU13.zh: 尚无晶壁契约的术士获得该契约，受到远程攻击时防御战斗力+10%。
FC Ruin RU13.en: a Warlock without Crystal Ward Covenant gains it, receiving +10% defensive Strength against ranged attacks.

FC Ruin RU14.zh: 拥有生命调息、尚无泉林契约的探索单位获得泉林契约，恢复时额外恢复5生命。
FC Ruin RU14.en: an exploring unit with Breath of Life but without Springwood Covenant gains the latter, healing an extra 5 HP when healing.

FC Ruin RU15.zh: 研究测绘后、研究战争统筹前，且已拥有城市时，一支巡林斥候在遗迹处加入。
FC Ruin RU15.en: after Cartography but before War Coordination, if you own a city, a Woodland Scouts joins you at the ruin.

FC Ruin RU16.zh: 研究测绘后，揭示探索单位周围5格内的地图。
FC Ruin RU16.en: after Cartography, reveal the map within 5 tiles of the exploring unit.

FC Ruins choice explanation.zh: 每次遭遇选择一个选项。条件不满足的选项不可选；伤害、治疗、经验和晋升作用于探索遗迹的单位。
FC Ruins choice explanation.en: Choose one response per encounter. Unmet requirements make an option unavailable. Damage, healing, experience and promotions apply to the unit exploring the ruin.

FC Encounter E16 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【灵魂辨识】后；陆地军事单位。
FC Encounter E16 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Soul Recognition; a land military unit.

FC Encounter E16-A Requirements.zh: 条件：至少拥有一座城市。

FC Encounter E16-B Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于20；探索部队不是镜仪侦测队或无声司镜；尚未拥有镜瞳训练/洞察术/封印感应。
FC Encounter E16-B Requirements.en: Requires: explorer health above 20; not Mirror Detection Team or Silent Mirror Keeper; does not have Mirror-Eye Training, Insight, Seal Detection.

FC Encounter E16-B result.zh: 损失20生命，获得封印感应。

FC Encounter E17 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【符文工艺】后；军事单位；遗迹2格内有丘陵。
FC Encounter E17 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Runic Crafts; a military unit; a Hill within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E17-A Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队为术士或施法英雄；探索部队生命大于25；尚未拥有镜瞳训练。
FC Encounter E17-A Requirements.en: Requires: an elemental mage or spellcasting hero; explorer health above 25; does not have Mirror-Eye Training.

FC Encounter E17-A result.zh: 损失25生命，获得镜瞳训练。

FC Encounter E18 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【生息契约】后；陆地军事单位；遗迹2格内有森林。
FC Encounter E18 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Covenants of Life; a land military unit; a Forest within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E18-A Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于20。

FC Encounter E18-B Requirements.zh: 条件：已拥有生命调息；尚未拥有泉林契约；探索部队生命大于20。
FC Encounter E18-B Requirements.en: Requires: has Breath of Life; does not have Springwood Covenant; explorer health above 20.

FC Encounter E18-B result.zh: 损失20生命，获得泉林契约。

FC Encounter E19 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【远洋航行】后；陆地军事单位；遗迹3格内有水域。
FC Encounter E19 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Ocean Navigation; a land military unit; Water within 3 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E19-A Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于20；尚未拥有海陆转运。
FC Encounter E19-A Requirements.en: Requires: explorer health above 20; does not have Amphibious Transport.

FC Encounter E19-A result.zh: 损失20生命，获得海陆转运。

FC Encounter E19-B result.zh: 揭示10格内的水域，获得60文化。
FC Encounter E19-B result.en: Reveal Water within 10 tiles; gain 60 Culture.

FC Encounter E20 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【测绘】后；军事单位。
FC Encounter E20 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Cartography; a military unit.

FC Encounter E20-A result.zh: 揭示12格内的古代遗迹，获得30文化。
FC Encounter E20-A result.en: Reveal ancient ruins within 12 tiles; gain 30 Culture.

FC Encounter E20-B Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队尚未满生命。

FC Encounter E20-B result.zh: 揭示8格内的荒野营地，恢复20生命。
FC Encounter E20-B result.en: Reveal barbarian encampments within 8 tiles; heal 20 HP.

FC Encounter E24 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：由英雄探索遗迹。
FC Encounter E24 eligibility.en: Eligibility: A hero explores the ruin.

FC Encounter E24-C Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队尚未满生命。

FC Encounter E25 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【生息契约】后；陆地军事单位；遗迹2格内有森林。
FC Encounter E25 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Covenants of Life; a land military unit; a Forest within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E25-A Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于20。

FC Encounter E25-A result.zh: 支付160金币，损失20生命，招募泉路医师。
FC Encounter E25-A result.en: Pay 160 Gold, take 20 damage and recruit Springroad Physician.

FC Encounter E25-B Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队尚未满生命。

FC Encounter E26 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【灵魂辨识】后；陆地军事单位；遗迹2格内有丘陵。
FC Encounter E26 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Soul Recognition; a land military unit; a Hill within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E26-A result.zh: 支付240金币，招募碑誓行者。

FC Encounter E27 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【元素塑形】后；军事单位；遗迹2格内有丘陵。
FC Encounter E27 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Elemental Shaping; a military unit; a Hill within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E27-A Requirements.zh: 条件：至少有1份可用魔晶。
FC Encounter E27-A Requirements.en: Requires: at least one available Magic Crystal.

FC Encounter E27-A result.zh: 支付320金币，招募熔印使者。
FC Encounter E27-A result.en: Pay 320 Gold; recruit Molten Seal Envoy.

FC Encounter E28 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【精神协同】后；军事单位；遗迹2格内有丘陵。
FC Encounter E28 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Mental Coordination; a military unit; a Hill within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E28-A Requirements.zh: 条件：探索部队生命大于25。

FC Encounter E28-A result.zh: 支付160金币，损失25生命，招募无声司镜。
FC Encounter E28-A result.en: Pay 160 Gold, take 25 damage and recruit Silent Mirror Keeper.

FC Encounter E29 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【市民制度】后；启用宗教；陆地军事单位；遗迹2格内有森林。
FC Encounter E29 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Citizenship; religion enabled; a land military unit; a Forest within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E29-A result.zh: 支付240金币，招募明灯誓卫。

FC Encounter E30 eligibility.zh: 出现条件：研究【贸易宪章】后；陆地军事单位；遗迹2格内有道路。
FC Encounter E30 eligibility.en: Eligibility: After researching Trade Charters; a land military unit; a Road within 2 tiles of the ruin.

FC Encounter E30-A result.zh: 支付400金币，招募护商仲裁者。

FC Hero requirements H03.zh: 条件：城市3格内有己方森林。
FC Hero requirements H03.en: Requirements: An owned Forest lies within 3 tiles of the city.

FC Hero requirements H02.zh: 条件：城市建有魔法学院。
FC Hero requirements H02.en: Requirements: The city has a Magic Academy.

FC Hero requirements H04.zh: 条件：城市建有生息研所，且3格内有己方自然奇观。
FC Hero requirements H04.en: Requirements: The city has a Life Research Institute and an owned Natural Wonder within 3 tiles.

FC Hero requirements H09.zh: 条件：城市建有补给港且相邻浅海。
FC Hero requirements H09.en: Requirements: The city has a Supply Harbor and borders Coast.

FC Hero requirements H11.zh: 条件：城市建有精密工坊，且有可用的铁与魔晶。
FC Hero requirements H11.en: Requirements: The city has a Precision Workshop, with Iron and Mana Crystal available.

FC Recruitment common requirements.zh: 以下六种遭遇可以招募英雄：需已拥有城市、当前未拥有该英雄，且遗迹与国家奇观英雄合计少于2位。金币费用列在对应选项中。
FC Recruitment common requirements.en: The next six encounters can recruit heroes. You must own a city, not already own that hero, and have fewer than two heroes from ruins and national wonders combined. Gold costs are shown with each option.

FC Encounter E29 eligibility line 4.en: a Forest within 2 tiles of the ruin.
